> **AI‑powered automatic synchronisation** – never forget to `git push` again.  
> This repository uses a smart bash script that pulls, commits, and pushes changes with a timestamp, plus a full **PowerHub** system monitor and **Kali Linux** quick reference.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔁 **Auto Pull & Push** – always up‑to‑date with remote.
- 📅 **Timestamped commits** – clear history (`Auto sync at YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).
- 🤖 **AI Code Generation & Auto‑Attack Defence** – simulated self‑defence and optimisation.
- ⚡ **PowerHub Dashboard** – real‑time (mock) system stats.
- 🐉 **Kali Linux Quick Reference** – essential commands and security tips.
- 🧠 **File Builder & Code Resolver** – automatically generates/updates components.
